distribution_reason: robots.txt 가 자동 수집을 차단한다. 우회 레시피는 아니지만, 사이트가 명시적으로 거부한 대상의 즉시 실행 가능한 수집 레시피를 배포하지 않는다.
notes: robots.txt blocks automated collection; proceed only after the user confirms express written Instagram/Meta permission. Manual Instagram login is required and session state stays in output cookies.json. Use at least 10s initial load, 5s after each scroll, 5s DOM watch, and 15 stable rounds. On 2026-07-14 the hashtag route yielded 219 unique /p/ shortcodes; 200 were collected and validated. The hashtag and keyword routes plus GraphQL product_type=clips yielded no /reel/ items, so reels were correctly reported as 0 rather than reclassifying video posts.
